name: diagnosing-flakes
title_zh: 复现不了的红色 CI，从失败日志倒推竞态根因
tagline_zh: 重跑就绿、只在 CI 挂、只在负载高时超时——这类没人能复现的红，它不猜「大概是异步」，而是拿失败日志。
tagline_en: Green on rerun, red only in CI, timing out under load — instead of guessing 'probably async', it narrows the.
desc_en: Use when a test or CI job fails probabilistically — passes on rerun, fails on one platform only, fails under load, or fails in CI but not locally. Also use when asked to investigate a flaky test, a red run nobody can reproduce, or an intermittent timeout. DO NOT invoke to design a new test for isolation — route that to ledger:designing-concurrent-tests.
why_zh: 先问「这个失败能不能稳定造出来」，造不出来就继续收证据，绝不先改代码。
why_en: It asks 'can I reproduce this on demand?' first, and keeps gathering evidence until it can — never patching code on a hunch.
limit_zh: 只做诊断，不负责改测试结构；要设计隔离用的新测试请转 designing-concurrent-tests。日志。
limit_en: Diagnosis only — it won't restructure your tests; route new isolation tests to designing-concurrent-tests. Without logs, platform, or timing.
title_en: Trace a flaky CI failure back to its race condition
